commit_sha_note: Null by construction: this receipt is committed INSIDE the commit it describes, so it cannot contain that commit's own hash. The sha lives in the queue's archive block for this task, which is where tools/research_dispatch.py reads it. Committing the receipt in a SEPARATE commit so it could name the sha is the defect recorded as GOAL-HAWK-001 BATCH-001 known_defect; it is not repeated here.
path_sha256_note: This receipt's own hash is necessarily absent here, for the same reason commit_sha is null. The complete three-path map, including this receipt, is recorded in the queue's archive.path_sha256 after the commit, and that is the map the dispatcher verifies against Git.
record_ids_note: Empty on purpose. This snapshot freezes a working artifact for review; it creates no ledger record. Record IDs appear at the ledger archive TASK-20260802-a157ad.
what_this_snapshot_does_not_establish: It does NOT adopt ISD-FC-2026. The convention is PROPOSED and binds only if a Coordinator ledger archive adopts it by name and version.
It does NOT confirm any item in the convention is correctly derived — 23 of its 47 items are the producing agent's own choice, which is precisely what the red team is dispatched to test.
It asserts nothing about HQC or SDitH security, and no claim tier moves.
A passing snapshot gate confirms the artifact is frozen and hash-bound. It is not a review verdict.
